text_block_list.text:
—The day of the Spring Thanksgiving 
Festival—

text_block_list.name: Commentator Umamusume
text_block_list.text:
In this year's Selected Ultra Tug-of-War, 
Gentildonna dominated once again! She took 
down 30 people all on her own!

text_block_list.name: Admire Groove
text_block_list.text:
(The events are utterly absurd every 
single year...)

text_block_list.name: Duramente
text_block_list.text:
Incredible... I would love to compete 
against them next year.

text_block_list.name: Admire Groove
text_block_list.text: ...I think I'll pass.

text_block_list.name: Commentator Umamusume
text_block_list.text:
Our next event is the 'Duo Steeplechase'! 
All competitors, please find a partner and 
gather around!

text_block_list.name: Duramente
text_block_list.text:
"This is the event you're competing in, 
right? Best of luck."

text_block_list.name: Admire Groove
text_block_list.text:
(I'm not really feeling this kind of 
event, ...but basically everyone is 
supposed to participate.)

text_block_list.name: Admire Groove
text_block_list.text:
...Yes. I'll do what I can within my 
limits.

text_block_list.name: Commentator Umamusume
text_block_list.text:
The "Duo Steeplechase" is an obstacle 
course race using the entire school 
grounds!

text_block_list.name: Commentator Umamusume
text_block_list.text:
Teamwork is essential to clear this 
attraction! Let's join forces and do our 
best~!

text_block_list.name: Admire Groove
text_block_list.text: ...Universe-san.

text_block_list.name: Neo Universe
text_block_list.text: —Sfera.

text_block_list.name: Neo Universe
text_block_list.text:
"Neo Universe will do 'try our best' 
together with Rob Roy."

text_block_list.name: Zenno Rob Roy
text_block_list.text:
H-Hello! I'll do my best together with 
Uni-san!

text_block_list.name: Admire Groove
text_block_list.text: Yes.

Zenno Rob Roy is a book-loving Umamusume 
who looks up to heroic tales. A close 
friend who ran alongside Neo Universe in 
the Classic races.

text_block_list.name: Admire Groove
text_block_list.text:
(A two-person team... Who will my partner 
be...?)

text_block_list.name: Still in Love
text_block_list.text: Ah...

text_block_list.name: Admire Groove
text_block_list.text: ...! Still-san...

text_block_list.name: Still in Love
text_block_list.text:
...I look forward... to working with 
you...

text_block_list.name: Admire Groove
text_block_list.text: ...Yes.

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text:
――... Those two seem a bit awkward around 
each other, will they be all right...?

text_block_list.name: Duramente
text_block_list.text:
Still in Love... Your Triple Tiara 
rival... But your values are polar 
opposites, aren't they?

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text:
Yeah. ...Hopefully, they've opened up to 
each other a bit.

text_block_list.name: Commentator Umamusume
text_block_list.text: And they're off!

text_block_list.name: Neo Universe
text_block_list.text: First... to the initial "coordinates."

text_block_list.name: Zenno Rob Roy
text_block_list.text: Yes, Uni-san! I'll give it my all too...!

text_block_list.name: Commentator Umamusume
text_block_list.text:
Now for the checkpoint! The attraction 
here is... "Dance 'n' Make Friends"!

text_block_list.name: Commentator Umamusume
text_block_list.text:
Unless you perform a dance in perfect 
sync, you cannot pass!

text_block_list.name: Zenno Rob Roy
text_block_list.text:
Match the movements... If I can't do it 
right, I'm sorry!

text_block_list.name: Neo Universe
text_block_list.text:
“—It'll be okay. As long as Rob Roy and... 
'I' are together.”

text_block_list.name: Commentator Umamusume
text_block_list.text:
Whoa! Neo Universe dashingly takes the 
lead over Zenno Rob Roy!

text_block_list.name: Commentator Umamusume
text_block_list.text: Clear! A completely effortless clear!

text_block_list.name: Still in Love
text_block_list.text:
Dancing together in sync... Something like 
that...

text_block_list.name: Admire Groove
text_block_list.text: —Yeah, that's impossible.

text_block_list.name: Admire Groove
text_block_list.text: ...If it were us from last year, maybe.

text_block_list.name: Still in Love
text_block_list.text: Groove-san...?

text_block_list.name: Admire Groove
text_block_list.text:
Let's do it. We both have people we can't 
bear to show ourselves losing to, right?

text_block_list.name: Still in Love
text_block_list.text: ..................That is right, yes.

text_block_list.name: Commentator Umamusume
text_block_list.text:
Oh! It looks like it took some time, but 
they've started dancing!

text_block_list.name: Admire Groove
text_block_list.text:
One-two-three, one-two-three. You're half 
a beat off.

text_block_list.name: Still in Love
text_block_list.text: Yes...!

text_block_list.name: Commentator Umamusume
text_block_list.text:
Whoa, they're gradually getting in sync! A 
brilliant breakthrough! It's truly 
anyone's game now, isn't it~?

Surprisingly, the two put up quite a 
fight. And—the result was...

text_block_list.name: Commentator Umamusume
text_block_list.text:
The winners are... the Neo Universe & 
Zenno Rob Roy team!

text_block_list.name: Admire Groove
text_block_list.text:
...In the end, we lost, didn't we? I 
suppose that's to be expected for 
something thrown together on the fly.

text_block_list.name: Still in Love
text_block_list.text: ...You're right.

text_block_list.name: Commentator Umamusume
text_block_list.text:
The winners are... the Admire Groove & 
Still in Love team!

text_block_list.name: Admire Groove
text_block_list.text:
Well... of course it turns out this way. 
If I could have made you my ally, you'd be 
the strongest. I've known that since last 
year.

text_block_list.name: Still in Love
text_block_list.text:
"...I was thinking the same thing... How 
wonderful it would be if we could join 
forces."

With the passage of time, it seemed their 
relationship had changed, if only 
slightly.

—At the after-party. The two fell silent, 
not saying a word for a while.

text_block_list.name: Admire Groove
text_block_list.text: Ever since then...

text_block_list.name: Admire Groove
text_block_list.text:
"It's been a little while since the Triple 
Tiara, but looks like you're managing 
somehow."

text_block_list.name: Still in Love
text_block_list.text:
Yes... After losing to you at the Queen 
Elizabeth II Cup, I was at a total loss, 
but...

text_block_list.name: Still in Love
text_block_list.text:
"Even so... no matter what... I feel I 
must dedicate a new glory to you."

text_block_list.name: Still in Love
text_block_list.text:
That's why next time... next time for 
sure...

text_block_list.name: Still in Love
text_block_list.text: I want to win. At the Takarazuka Kinen.

text_block_list.name: Admire Groove
text_block_list.text:
I see... you're entering too, then— the 
"Takarazuka Kinen." In that case...

text_block_list.name: Admire Groove
text_block_list.text:
A challenge, then. Let's see which of us 
can show our beloved person what victory 
looks like.

text_block_list.name: Still in Love
text_block_list.text: Groove-san...

text_block_list.name: Admire Groove
text_block_list.text:
Just so you know, unlike you, I'm not 
dependent on anyone.

text_block_list.name: Admire Groove
text_block_list.text:
I only wish—to pass this running on, if 
there is anyone worthy of inheriting it.

text_block_list.name: Admire Groove
text_block_list.text:
"I'm sure she can take it even further. 
That's why..."

text_block_list.name: Still in Love
text_block_list.text:
Is that so? You also have someone you care 
for deeply... In that case—

text_block_list.name: Still in Love
text_block_list.text:
That means I'll have another chance to 
take it, yes?

text_block_list.name: Admire Groove
text_block_list.text:
Yes... But make sure you don't get 
counterattacked instead.

text_block_list.name: Admire Groove
text_block_list.text:
I'm strong, you know. Stronger than 
before.
